# Rafael Mouallem Rosa

I am a postdoctoral researcher at Inria working on Bayesian inference and Bayesian machine learning.

My research centers on the **Sources of Uncertainty** framework, which extends Bayesian inference by allowing different components of a probabilistic model to be associated with different levels of confidence. I use this framework to study sparsity-inducing Bayesian methods, with current applications to Bayesian neural networks.

Before joining Inria, I completed a Ph.D. in Economics, working on decision theory, and later worked in financial markets as a quantitative portfolio manager. Across these experiences, a common theme has been uncertainty: the axiomatic representation of agents’ choices under uncertainty, real confrontation with uncertainty in financial markets, and the modelling of uncertainty in Bayesian statistical learning.

## Selected work

**Bayesian inference with sources of uncertainty: from confidence modelling to sparse estimation**
Rafael Mouallem Rosa, Julyan Arbel, Hien Duy Nguyen.
arXiv preprint, 2026.
[[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03134)]

Introduces the Sources of Uncertainty framework for Bayesian inference and develops SoU-SGL, a sparsity-inducing Bayesian method with applications to linear regression, logistic regression, and Bayesian neural networks.
